危機中的接班人選

作者介紹，輝達財務長柯萊特・克瑞斯據稱受命擔任公司臨時執行長，外界因此關注她能否接下黃仁勳留下的重任。彭博分析指出，企業遭逢危機時，董事會常由財務長暫時掌舵：財務長熟悉公司狀況，也與投資人、銀行及客戶往來，較能傳遞「公司仍然穩定」的訊息。克瑞斯在輝達任職十三年，熟悉營運各面向，分析人士形容她如同公司的瑞士刀，實際職責也接近營運長。

低調務實的風格與危機考驗

克瑞斯的作風與擅長站上舞台、談論未來願景的黃仁勳大不相同。她行事低調、發言謹慎，熟識她的人則認為她務實、冷靜，必要時也敢對黃仁勳說「不」。不過，她在輝達的職涯並非一路順遂。2018年，加密貨幣價格下跌，礦工停止採購顯示卡，通路商因此囤積大量庫存。公司原先預期庫存會迅速消化，實際復甦速度卻比預想緩慢；輝達宣布下一季營收將大幅低於市場預期後，股價兩天內重挫逾28%，克瑞斯與黃仁勳也遭股東訴訟指控未充分揭露挖礦需求對營收的影響。這場風波讓克瑞斯必須同時處理財務壓力與市場信心崩落。

從財務專業走進輝達

克瑞斯現年59歲，並非工程師或公司創辦人，而是長年深耕科技業財務管理的專業人士。她在亞利桑那大學攻讀金融並取得MBA，先後於德州儀器、微軟及思科任職，累積近25年的科技業財務管理經驗。2013年，46歲的她已在思科擔任高階主管，生活與工作相對穩定；當時規模遠不如微軟、思科的輝達，主要以遊戲顯示卡聞名。她的兩個兒子熱愛電玩，知道輝達顯示卡的實力，便鼓勵母親接受邀請。真正說服她的則是黃仁勳：他以白板描繪人工智慧的未來，指出原本用於遊戲的GPU終有一天會成為AI的重要基礎。

公司文化與財富累積

克瑞斯也重視企業文化，認為留住人才不只靠加薪。她主張領導者應聆聽各階層員工的意見，讓最了解專案的人能發揮影響力，不因職稱高低而被忽略，也應營造持續學習新技能的環境。影片並提到，隨著輝達股價與公司價值攀升，她持有的公司股票大幅增值；報導援引《富比士》估算，她的身家達12億美元，躋身美國富有的白手起家女性之列。

「玻璃懸崖」與領導挑戰

克瑞斯在公司動盪時接掌重任，也引發外界對「玻璃懸崖」的討論。這個概念指女性往往在組織陷入危機時才獲得高階職位，接下成功機率較低、失敗風險較高的任務；若未能扭轉局勢，外界又可能將結果歸咎於女性不適合領導。影片以雅虎前執行長瑪麗莎・梅爾、前美國副總統賀錦麗及英國前首相特拉斯等案例，說明女性與少數族群有時會在局勢不利時承擔重任。作者提醒，玻璃懸崖並不代表女性注定失敗；克瑞斯能否成功，除了取決於她的領導能力，也取決於董事會願意給予多少權力與支持。影片最後邀請觀眾討論，沒有黃仁勳的輝達能否繼續發光。

Who would have thought that 13 years later, this company would become the global titan of the AI industry, and that this mother would become a multi-millionaire? What's more, she has now actually become NVIDIA's interim CEO. We’ve covered quite a few stories on Chinese espionage and Jensen Huang stepping down here on " Today at the World" recently. CFO Colette Kress has been appointed to take on the hot potato of interim CEO. What is her background, really? Does she have what it takes to clean up the mess left behind by Jensen Huang? Hello everyone, I’m Kelly. Welcome to this episode of "Person in Focus." Why would NVIDIA’s board turn to Colette to put out the fire? Bloomberg analyzes that this is actually a typical approach for American companies when facing a crisis. When a company suddenly runs into trouble and needs someone to take the helm, the board often turns to the CFO, because the CFO not only. understands the company's financial status best but also regularly deals with investors, banks, and clients, giving them the credibility and network to stabilize the situation during chaos . A U.S. corporate executive told Bloomberg that in times of crisis, a CFO is often the most suitable interim leader, because at such times, the company doesn't need grand visions, but rather the message: "We are still stable ; there is no need to panic." And Colette is no ordinary CFO; she has been at NVIDIA for 13 years, which is more than double the average tenure for a CFO at a major U.S. corporation. Tech.

analysts describe her as someone indispensable to everything Jensen does ; she is like NVIDIA’s Swiss Army knife , able to handle anything, and her actual role is closer to that of an COO . Interestingly, her personality is almost the polar opposite of Jensen Huang’s. You might recall that back then, Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies were surging. That November, Kress admitted at an earnings call that the company had expected the inventory to clear quickly. Things didn't go as planned; the market recovered slower than expected. Stand firm. At 59, Kress differs from Jensen Huang in that she is neither an engineer nor a founder; she has spent half her life managing finances at tech companies. She studied finance at the University of Arizona and later earned an MBA. Her first long-term role was at Texas Instruments, followed by 13 years at Microsoft, where she served as CFO for the Server and Tools division, before moving to Cisco in 2010 as a senior VP and divisional CFO. Simply put, she has accumulated nearly. 25 years of financial management experience in the tech industry. The turning point in her life came in 2013. At 46, she was already a senior executive at Cisco with a stable career when Jensen Huang came to recruit her as NVIDIA's CFO. However, NVIDIA was much smaller back then compared to giants like Microsoft or Cisco, focusing primarily on graphics cards, with gaming GPUs being their most well-known product . While she was hesitant, two career advisors appeared at home: her then eight and ten-year-old sons. Kress told Bloomberg that her sons loved gaming and already knew how powerful NVIDIA's graphics cards were, so they encouraged their mother to join the company. Of course, while the kids ' advice was one thing, it was Jensen Huang who truly convinced her. Huang personally walked her through NVIDIA's future plans, even using a whiteboard to sketch out his vision for the AI industry. At the time, when people thought of NVIDIA, they only thought of gaming and pretty 3D graphics, but Huang convinced her otherwise. He argued that the GPUs originally used for gaming would one day become the essential foundation for AI, which is why Kress.

decided to accept the challenge. She also places great importance on the company's culture, believing that retaining talent requires more than just raises. Beyond a comprehensive benefits system, he emphasized in an interview with Fortune that good leaders should be willing to listen to employees at all levels, not just those in the highest positions. He said that at Quora, the organization is relatively flat; if you are the one who understands a project best, the company should listen to your input regardless of your job title, while also fostering an environment where employees. learn new skills and knowledge every day . Over 13 years, thanks to her Quora stock , Forbes estimates D'Angelo's net worth reached $ 1.2 billion this June, making her one of America's wealthiest self-made women. Ranked 32nd on the list, this job. Not only changed her life but also her bank. However, as she steps in to put out the fire, some foreign media have begun to discuss the "glass cliff" phenomenon. You may have heard of the "glass ceiling. ," which refers to the invisible barriers women often encounter; the " glass cliff" is a concept proposed by British scholars in 2005, where women finally reach high-level positions just as a company enters a crisis, the moment they are most likely to fail. Subsequent studies found that minorities face similar situations, most notably. The famous case of Yahoo hiring former Google executive Marissa Mayer as CEO in 2012, though Yahoo had long been beaten by Google by then. She worked hard to reform the company for five years, but in the end, its core business was sold.

to Verizon. This phenomenon also appears in politics; scholars believe U.S. Vice President Kamala Harris was thrust into the race just months before the election , and former UK Prime Minister Liz Truss took office when the economy was already unstable; her policies caused market turmoil and backlash, leading her to resign after just 45 days, with netizens cruelly joking that her tenure was shorter than a head of lettuce. Stanford sociologists point out that sometimes women take over messes left by others, and if they fail to turn things around, the public easily blames them,. concluding, "See? Women just aren't fit to be leaders." It’s like giving women an almost impossible task, then using their failure to prove women lack capability; this bias makes it even harder for other women to advance. Of course, the glass cliff doesn't mean a woman’s attempt to save a company is doomed to fail; there are successful cases, and the public shouldn't be so quick to write off Quora's new leader. Whether this opportunity becomes the greatest achievement of her career or she falls off the glass cliff depends not just on her own leadership, but also on the power and support the board is willing to grant her. 摘要

生育焦慮與「卵子最大化」

台灣生育率低迷，不只反映有人選擇不生，也掩蓋了許多人想要孩子、卻難以順利懷孕的處境。有人尋求試管嬰兒、捐卵或捐精，也有人跨國尋找代理孕母；而在美國矽谷，部分人更試圖把生育推向極限，想在胚胎植入前比較基因，挑選理想中的孩子。

三十歲的康納得知妻子自然受孕不易後，開始研究如何改善精子品質，少喝酒、改穿寬鬆內褲、避免手機放在口袋，並服用營養補充品。網路上甚至有人以冰水浸泡睪丸，希望增加精子生成；但即使後來成功懷孕，也難以確認究竟是哪種方法發揮作用。與此同時，矽谷一個名為「Egg Rolling」的女性社群，成員致力於反覆取卵、累積數十甚至數百顆卵子，這種做法被稱為「卵子最大化」，有些人希望藉此保留生育機會，有些人則想日後培養更多胚胎並進行基因篩選。

台灣生育率低迷，不只反映有人選擇不生，也掩蓋了許多人想要孩子、卻難以順利懷孕的處境。有人尋求試管嬰兒、捐卵或捐精，也有人跨國尋找代理孕母；而在美國矽谷，部分人更試圖把生育推向極限，想在胚胎植入前比較基因，挑選理想中的孩子。

  • 深入解析黃仁勳卸任執行長對輝達（Nvidia）短期營運與長期策略接班的全面影響。
  • 探討後黃仁勳時代對美國 AI 資料中心建設、融資擔保以及美中晶片監管政策的潛在連鎖衝擊。
  • 剖析台灣半導體與伺服器供應鏈（如台積電、廣達、緯創等）所面臨的訂單風險與轉型機遇。

摘要

黃仁勳震撼交棒，輝達短期穩健但長線考驗接班智慧

作者指出，輝達董事會突然宣布黃仁勳辭去執行長職務，由財務長柯蕾特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）暫代職務。消息公布初期引發市場震盪，但散戶迅速進場承接，市場普遍認為輝達已非一人公司，單季營收規模龐大且未來一至兩年的晶片設計與生產排程早已確立，短期出貨受衝擊有限。然而，長期隱憂在於黃仁勳過去親力親為建立的亞洲供應鏈同盟與個人魅力，非工程師出身的克雷斯及未來的正式接班人是否能維持強大技術視野與擴張野心，將是輝達能否維持 AI 霸權的最大關鍵。

外溢效應擴大：AI資料中心建置放緩與政策風向轉變
